observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — overview
observations.content:
Academic low-code MVP: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4 frontend; FastAPI + PaddleOCR single-file backend.
Repo: https://github.com/javi2481/document-intelligence.git
Philosophy: max ~10 app files, no Zustand/Konva/shadcn/Celery/multi-OCR engines.
Structure: frontend/ (App.tsx, api.ts, index.css) + backend/main.py + requirements.txt + README.md
Formats: PNG JPG WEBP GIF BMP TIFF ICO PPM + PDF first page (normalized to PNG).
Run: backend `python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000`; frontend `npm run dev` → http://localhost:5173
PaddleOCR init needs enable_mkldnn=False; uses predict() API; PADDLE_PDX_CACHE_HOME in backend/.paddlex
Export is client-side (JSON/CSV/TXT) so edits are included.
Theme dark-first with localStorage.

observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — continue on another PC
observations.content:
git clone https://github.com/javi2481/document-intelligence.git
cd document-intelligence/backend && python3.11 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
# other terminal:
cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev

First PaddleOCR run downloads models (slow).
